Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About Us: 
 20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles . 
 What you’ll find here: 
Digital transformation projects with real impact
A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
Exposure to diverse industries and international environments
Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are looking for a Mobile Test Analyst to join our team!
 Key responsibilities 
Conduct test activities through different phases of testing – test strategy, test planning, test design, test execution, test reporting
Understand functional requirements or user stories
Define the Test strategy and perform Peer Review on the Test strategy
Prepare and execute test plans, test cases and test scenarios
Define test data needs
Analyze tests results, document issues, and retest corrections to ensure that the problems are solved
Perform Test case capitalization for Regression
Test Management, Defect Management and Reporting using Jira, Octane, Tosca or similar tools
Produce reporting/KPI for test progress and Closure
Review of test cases designed, improve, and optimize test process
Responsible for delivery of all testing documentation and execution of tests
Selection of test cases for automation & provide support for test automation
Gain an understanding of the business context and technical environment
 What we are looking for 
3-5 years previous experience in a similar role
Very good/advanced level of English
The ability to research on their own/get info from different stakeholders and developers
Good planning, organization, and time management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to communicate efficient with the team (business, developers, PO’s)
Excellent problem-solving skills
Knowledge of agile methodology
Experience in banking projects and strong understanding of banking processes and products
 Skill requirements & tech stack manual (Mobile projects) 
 Must Have: 
Manual mobile testing in BrowserStack and/ or on-site devices iOS & Android
Manual testing of web browsers
Previous experience with manual REST API testing (tools alike Postman, Bruno, Insomnia, etc.)
Proven experience in test case, test planning and test execution following internal procedures
 Nice to Have: 
 · ISTQB certification would be a plus
 📍Location: Bucharest 
 🏢Work type: hybrid, 2x/week 
 *Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
